page.title: Storage
page.description: Where models live: local directories on each node, NFS exports and shared directories. Open a storage to see its nodes and the model files in it.
page.empty: No storage yet. Add one so models have somewhere to live.

tag.readOnlyHelp: Disabled: files cannot be downloaded or copied into this storage, or deleted from it. Existing models can still be deployed. For NFS with local cache, node caches can still be filled and cleared.

capacity.perNode: Each node uses its own disk.
capacity.once: Every node sees the same volume, so its capacity is shown once.

overview.freeSpread: Free space per node: least {{min}} on {{minNode}}, most {{max}} on {{maxNode}}

nodes.ownDirectoryHint: This node cannot use the directory: edit the storage and give this node a directory of its own under the nodes it applies to.
nodes.offlineHint: Offline: showing what it last reported

files.emptyShared: No model files in this storage yet. Scan it to import the ones already there, or download a model into it from the Models page.
files.emptyLocal: Model files appear here after a model is downloaded, synchronised or registered on a node.
files.noMatch: No model file matches the filter
files.evictCache: Remove the cache on this node

browse.chooseNodeHint: A local storage is a directory on each node. Choose the node whose directory to browse.
browse.symlinkHint: A symbolic link is listed but never followed, so it cannot be opened or downloaded here.
browse.writableAreas: Only files/ and .gpuworks/apps/ can be changed. Everything else can be browsed and downloaded.

readonly.disabled: The storage is disabled, so it is read-only.
readonly.region: This location is read-only: only files/ and .gpuworks/apps/ can be changed.
readonly.regionRoot: {{name}} is a writable area itself: things go into it, but it cannot be renamed or deleted.
readonly.other: The server does not allow changes here now: the node cannot write to the storage, or an app is using this directory.

browse.deleteDescription: It is moved to the storage's trash and removed in the background. This cannot be undone.
browse.name: Name
browse.nameInvalid: Enter one name: not empty, not . or .., and without / or \.

uploadDialog.title: Upload to {{path}}
uploadDialog.pick: Click or drag a file here
uploadDialog.pickHint: One file per upload, sent in a single request. If the transfer breaks, the file has to be sent again in full.
uploadDialog.extractHint: Absolute paths, .., links and device files in the archive are refused, and the unpacked size is limited.
uploadDialog.noExtract: Only .tar, .tar.gz (.tgz) and .zip files can be unpacked.
uploadDialog.processing: Sent. The node is putting it into place…
uploadDialog.overwriteHint: Overwrite moves the existing one to the storage's trash first, or choose another name.
uploadDialog.networkError: The connection broke during the upload. Check the network and upload again.

detail.notReady: This storage is not ready on {{count}} of {{total}} node(s)
detail.refreshFailed: Refresh failed. Displayed capacity and status may be out of date.
detail.title: Storage details

actions.clearCacheConfirm: Clear the node caches of this storage?
actions.clearCacheHelp: Only caches that no instance or active deployment reads are removed. Files on the NFS stay.
actions.switchHelp: Only later starts are affected; the files on the NFS stay where they are.
actions.switchFromCacheHelp: Node caches are cleared first; the files on the NFS stay, and cleared caches are not restored. The switch stops if a node is unreachable or a cached model is in use, still copying, failed to copy, or has no copy on the NFS.
actions.deleteDefaultBlocked: The default storage cannot be deleted. Set another storage as the default first.
actions.deleteHelp: Model files stay on the nodes. Models stored only in this storage are removed from the model list. A storage a deployment uses cannot be removed.
actions.deleteSharedHelp: Files on the shared storage are not deleted; this storage record and its heartbeat are removed. Models stored only in this storage are removed from the model list. A storage a deployment uses cannot be removed.

typeHelp.local: A directory on each node. Every node holds its own copy of a model file.
typeHelp.nfs: An NFS export mounted on the nodes and read in place. One copy serves every node.
typeHelp.nfs_cache: An NFS export that is the source of truth; each node copies what it starts into a local cache with a size limit.
typeHelp.shared_dir: A shared directory already mounted on the nodes (CephFS, Lustre, your own NFS mount). The agent only checks it and does not mount it.

form.name: Name
form.nameHelp: 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
form.exportHelp: host:/path. One export is registered only once.
form.exportLocked: An export cannot be changed; add a new storage for another one.
form.pathHelp: The directory on the node that holds model files, independent of where the agent is installed. The agent makes sure it exists and reports its capacity. A node that cannot use it can get its own directory.
form.sharedPathHelp: The path where the directory is already mounted on the nodes.
form.mountPointHelp: Where the nodes mount the export; the default is {{mount}}.
form.mountOptionsHelp: Checked against an allow-list and passed to mount -o as they are, never through a shell. Leave the rest to the kernel.
form.cachePathHelp: Where each node keeps its cache. It can be moved to another disk per node.
form.cacheMaxHelp: 0 means no limit. A model larger than the limit is refused rather than read from the NFS instead.

scope.title: Applies to
scope.mixedHelp: This storage applies to nodes in more than one way (by label and one by one); all of it is kept when you save.
scope.mixedAll: Every node, including nodes added later
scope.allHelp: Every node, including nodes added later.
scope.overrideNodes: Nodes that use another directory (optional): pick a node, then give its directory
scope.labelsHelp: Nodes carrying these labels; a node that gets the label later is included.

error.name: Use 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
error.cacheLimit: Enter a positive capacity within the supported range, or select unlimited.

form.savedReadOnly: Storage {{name}} was saved read-only (disabled) because nothing could be written to it.

probe.running: Mounting and checking on a node…
probe.required: Run the trial mount first; the storage can only be saved once it passes.
probe.requestFailed: The trial mount could not run
probe.stale: The form changed after the trial mount. Run it again before saving.
probe.readOnlyNotice: Nothing could be written, so it will be saved as read-only (disabled): it can be scanned and deployed from, but not downloaded into or deleted from.
probe.scope: This result applies only to this node and this check. It does not establish access from other nodes or continued availability.

scan.title: Scan and import: {{name}}
scan.help: One node walks the storage and lists the model directories it finds. Importing only records them in this gpuworks; nothing is copied.

skipReason.hf_hub_cache_layout: HuggingFace hub cache layout, not supported yet
skipReason.model_component: component of a model, not an independent entry
skipReason.multiple_model_entries: multiple model entries in one directory; import from separate directories
skipReason.invalid_model_metadata: model metadata is invalid or unreadable
skipReason.metadata_read_limit: metadata parsing exceeded its read limit; recognition is incomplete

metadataIssue.unknown_task: No supported evidence identifies the task
metadataIssue.metadata_read_limit: Metadata parsing exceeded its read limit; recognition is incomplete
metadataIssue.unverified_component: Component file layout could not be verified
metadataIssue.invalid_gguf_split: GGUF shard metadata does not match
metadataIssue.unresolved_gguf_split: GGUF shards could not be grouped
metadataIssue.unresolved_component_association: Shared GGUF component found; its association with this entry is not declared

controlPlanes.readOnly: Not tracked for a read-only storage: nothing here writes to or deletes from it.
controlPlanes.title: Other gpuworks using this storage
controlPlanes.none: No other gpuworks is using this storage.
controlPlanes.loadFailed: Could not read who else uses this storage

settings.title: Storage settings
settings.loadFailed: Failed to load the storage settings
settings.controlPlaneNameHelp: Other gpuworks sharing a storage see this name in their list of who is using it.
settings.reserveHelp: Free space kept on every node disk; model caches are evicted before they eat into it. Leave empty for the default.
settings.reserveDefault: Default: 10% of the disk, at most 50 GiB

cacheManage.inheritanceCount: {{inherited}} following default · {{overridden}} with a separate limit
cacheManage.search: Search node name, hostname or address
cacheManage.fixedSelection: These {{count}} nodes are fixed for this operation; future nodes are not included.
cacheManage.inactiveHelp: This exception is outside the current scope. Editing it will not add the node to the storage.
cacheManage.saved: Configuration saved. Check each node for cleanup progress.
cacheManage.invalidLimit: Enter a positive finite capacity within the safe integer byte range, or explicitly choose no limit.
cacheManage.invalidPath: Enter an absolute directory path without parent-directory traversal.
cacheManage.budgetHelp: Limits are cache budgets, not reserved disk space. Disk free space and the reserve still apply, including when several caches share a disk. Disabling the storage only prevents writes to the NFS model library; node caches can still be filled and cleared.
cacheManage.impact: {{count}} affected · {{over}} over the proposed limit · {{blocked}} blocked by protected caches · {{offline}} offline
cacheManage.protectedHelp: Protected caches may be in use, transferring, or lack a shared backup. Cleanup never removes these files. The quota budget includes the remaining bytes of in-progress transfers; cached usage shows only data already on disk.
cacheManage.unknownImpact: Usage is unknown for {{count}} node(s); the impact cannot yet be confirmed.
cacheManage.defaultImpact: {{count}} nodes with separate limits keep their values.
cacheManage.pathChangeHelp: Changing a directory does not move existing files. Its capacity must be checked on the node; in-use paths are protected by the server.
cacheManage.filesUnknown: Model details are unavailable; protected bytes must not be assumed reclaimable.
cacheManage.queued: Cleanup requested for {{count}} nodes; completion is reported per node.
cacheManage.clearHelp: Only unused, non-transferring caches with a shared backup are removed. Offline nodes wait to reconnect. The selected set is fixed and failures remain visible.
cacheManage.knownUsage: {{value}} across {{count}} of {{total}} nodes with known usage

reason.directory_unverified: Waiting for the node to verify the cache directory.
reason.disk_unverified: Waiting for the node to report available disk space.
reason.cleanup_required: Cache cleanup is required to meet the configured budget.
reason.cache_full_in_use: Protected caches prevent meeting the cache budget.
reason.insufficient_disk: Available disk space is insufficient after safe cleanup.
reason.model_exceeds_cache_limit: The model is larger than this node's cache limit.

cacheDraft.pathNotice: Changing a directory does not move existing files. Capacity must be measured again for the new directory.
cacheDraft.empty: No matching nodes. Existing inactive settings are retained.
cacheDraft.defaultHelp: Each node has its own budget. New matching nodes follow this default; available disk space still limits cache growth.
cacheDraft.defaultImpact: Affects {{count}} nodes following defaults; {{own}} keep individual limits.
cacheDraft.trimImpact: {{over}} nodes exceed the new limit. Their reclaimable cache: {{reclaimable}}; protected cache: {{protected}}. Safe cleanup runs after saving.
cacheDraft.unknownImpact: {{unknown}} nodes need fresh capacity data. Protected files are retained, including referenced, transferring and sole-copy cache.
cacheDraft.previewLoading: Loading node cache facts; capacity impact is not known yet.
cacheDraft.previewFailed: Could not load node cache facts. Capacity impact is unknown; retry to preview it.
cacheDraft.previewIncomplete: The response did not include all node cache facts.
